identity.title: Identity
identity.photoHint: JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF, up to 5 MB. It is cropped to a square.

photo.title: New profile photo
photo.removeBody: Signed-in users will see your initials instead.

details.title: Details
details.hint: Your display name and photo are shown to signed-in users. Your bio, country and city are only for you.
details.displayNameHint: Up to 40 characters. Empty shows your username.

email.removeBody: Your account will have no email address. There is no password recovery by email either way.

copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it by hand.

reauth.title: Confirm it's you
reauth.text: For your security, confirm your identity to continue.

security.subtitle: Your password, two-factor authentication and signed-in devices.

password.othersNote: Changing your password signs out your other devices.
password.setHint: Add a password to sign in without Discord or Google.

mfa.title: Two-factor authentication
mfa.hint: Ask for a code from an authenticator app when you sign in.
mfa.unavailable: Two-factor authentication is not available on this server.
mfa.scan: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app, or enter this key by hand.
mfa.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
mfa.enterCode: Enter the 6-digit code your app shows.
mfa.codesText: Each code works once if you lose your phone. Keep them somewhere safe; you will not see them again.
mfa.saved: I saved these codes somewhere safe
mfa.enabled: Two-factor authentication is on. Your other devices were signed out.
mfa.disableText: Enter a code from your app or one of your recovery codes.
mfa.disabled: Two-factor authentication is off. Your other devices were signed out.
mfa.newCodesText: Your current codes stop working and your other devices are signed out.

sessions.title: Signed-in devices
sessions.hint: Where your account is signed in now.
sessions.signOutBody: {{device}} will need to sign in again.
sessions.othersBody: Every other browser and app will need to sign in again.

api.subtitle: A personal key to read your data from scripts.
api.title: API key
api.intro: A personal key to read your data (collection, decks, wishlists, products) from scripts and other tools. It can't change anything or open your account settings.
api.replaceBody: The current key stops working at once.
api.revokeBody: Scripts using it stop working at once.
api.warning: Copy it now. You will not see it again.
api.exampleNote: Only GET requests are allowed. Limit: 60 requests per minute.
